# Jubilees Chapter 1 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 1:1 — Opening formula: "exodus" vs. "going-out"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the going-out of the children-of-Israel" | Hyphenated literal of Ge'ez westa/nefqat |
| LOGOS | "the exodus of the children of Israel" | Standard English theological term |
| PNEUMA | "after Israel left Egypt" | Paraphrases the whole phrase |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Exodus" is precise and well-recognized; EMET's "going-out" is awkward; PNEUMA loses the formal register of the opening datum.

---

## 1:4 — "earlier history and later history" vs. "beginning to end"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the earlier-history and the later-history of the division of all the days" | Preserves the Ge'ez bipartite structure |
| LOGOS | "the earlier history and the later history of all the divisions of the days" | Formal equivalence, preserves structure |
| PNEUMA | "the whole story from beginning to end" | Collapses the bipartite form |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. The "earlier and later" formulation is a Jubilees technical distinction between primordial and eschatological history that PNEUMA erases.

---

## 1:16 — "plant of righteousness" / "planting of righteousness" / "righteous garden"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "plant-of righteousness" | Hyphenated construct chain |
| LOGOS | "planting of righteousness" | Scholarly rendering of the Enochic idiom |
| PNEUMA | "righteous garden" | Conveys agricultural metaphor accessibly |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS "planting of righteousness." This is a recognized terminus technicus in Enochic and Jubilees literature (cf. 1 Enoch 10:16, 93:2); PNEUMA's "garden" misdirects.

---

## 1:20 — "spirit of Beliar" scope

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the spirit-of Beliar rule over them to accuse them before you and ensnare them" | Full literal |
| LOGOS | "the spirit of Beliar rule over them to accuse them before you and lead them astray" | Formal, "lead them astray" for wayward path |
| PNEUMA | "Beliar — that spirit of accusation — rule over them, drag them into court before you, and lead them off every righteous path" | Explicates Beliar's dual function |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS with minor modification. PNEUMA's "drag them into court" is vivid but anachronistic. EMET's "ensnare" is fine but LOGOS's "lead them astray" better captures the path metaphor in context.

---

## 1:29 — angel of the presence takes "tablets" — content described

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the tablets of the divisions of the years from the time of the creation of the law and of the testimony for the weeks of jubilees" | Full literal, preserves Ge'ez list |
| LOGOS | "the tablets recording the divisions of the years — from creation, through the law and the testimony, through the weeks of jubilees" | Formal with light restructuring |
| PNEUMA | "the tablets that recorded all the divisions of time, from creation onward, through the jubilees and the years" | Compresses the list |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. The specificity of the list ("law," "testimony," "weeks," "jubilees") is structurally significant to Jubilees' self-description; PNEUMA's compression loses precision.

---

**Total disagreements: 5**
